`src/billing/tax.py` now rounds tax half-up. I didn't run or test it.

`tax_for` was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so I implemented it. It multiplies `amount_cents` by `rate` as a `Decimal` and rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. That means 0.5 cents rounds up to 1 cent.

An existing EngramDB decision recorded the March 2026 rule as banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), explicitly "never half-up". I took your message as the newer instruction and updated that memory to say half-up, so it no longer contradicts the code.

The memory's per-line rule still stands: round each line item's tax separately, then sum those rounded amounts. `tax_for` rounds one amount at a time, so whatever builds the invoice has to call it per line and add up the results.
